heading: Custom Baskets & Container Planting
intro: Let us bring your flower dreams to life. Our custom planting program is one of the most popular services at Columbia Nursery, and it’s easy to see why. Whether you’re refreshing your porch pots or decking out your entire garden, we’ll help you create stunning container displays suited to your space, sunlight, and style. Check out our idea portfolio.

steps.text: Bring in your own containers or choose from our wide selection of baskets, ceramic pots, and planters.
steps.fullText: Bring in your own containers or choose from our wide selection of baskets, ceramic pots, and planters.

steps.text: Tell us what you love — colors, styles, sun or shade — and we’ll design accordingly.
steps.fullText: Tell us what you love — colors, styles, sun or shade — and we’ll design accordingly.

steps.title: We custom plant it for you.
steps.text: Your containers are filled with vibrant annuals, lush foliage, and long-blooming combinations grown in our own greenhouses.
steps.fullText: We custom plant it for you. Your containers are filled with vibrant annuals, lush foliage, and long-blooming combinations grown in our own greenhouses.

steps.title: Pick up when ready.
steps.text: We’ll give you a timeline and care instructions to keep your arrangements thriving all season.
steps.fullText: Pick up when ready. We’ll give you a timeline and care instructions to keep your arrangements thriving all season.

benefits.title: Save time and avoid the mess
benefits.text: We plant your baskets early in the season & grow them indoors. By the time you pick them up, they are mature & full of blooms.

benefits.title: Get expertly designed containers tailored to your space
Support local greenhouse-grown flowers and foliage

customers: Each spring, our team creates thousands of custom baskets for homeowners, local businesses, landscapers, vacation properties, and resorts throughout the Flathead Valley. Let us do the same for you — whether it’s one basket or a hundred.
inspiration: Check out our idea book to see examples of color combinations, trailing varieties, and sun/shade arrangements. From classic petunia mixes to tropical spiller-thrillers, we’ve planted them all.
